_comment: Source-priority rules for resolving cross-document contradictions (architecture §7, e.g. 'Financials > Application > Email'). When sources disagree, the value from the highest-priority source class wins; a field that agrees with that source is NOT flagged for review. A source is classified by filename keyword (filename_classes) first, else by its document kind. Lower index = higher priority. Within the SAME priority class, 'degraded_source_types' (OCR/scanned/image) are tie-broken BELOW clean digital sources, so a clean PDF beats a noisy scan of the same form. Override with NEVAG_SOURCE_PRIORITY_PATH; per-attribute order via by_attribute.
